verdict.limitations: The sensitivity for detecting a small pneumothorax on plain radiographs can be limited, especially in supine views or with subtle findings. Small or apical pneumothoraces may not be clearly visible on these images. The images are not specifically optimized for pneumothorax detection (e.g., expiratory views are not provided). The sensitivity of plain radiographs for detecting small pneumothoraces can be limited, especially in supine views or with subtle findings. Overlying soft tissue or bony structures can obscure a small pneumothorax. Without clinical correlation or additional imaging, a very small pneumothorax cannot be entirely excluded.
